  • Helping mitigate some of the issues with Hot sorting that are still around by offering a middle ground between the two
  • Help prevent good discussion from being buried under circlejerks

Chan sites and classical style forums still use this sorting method every day, and it would give posts that generate thoughtful discussion a different kind of advantage over popular posts while still allowing for vote-based sorting.
